text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Arghhh. What the heck? The pounding's killin' me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My head's been throbbin' since this mornin'. Maybe someone's talkin' about me behind my back…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, no. That's sneezes, right? What causes headaches, then?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Owww. Shouting made it worse. I can't even crack jokes now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her headache troubling her, Tamamo Cross tries to keep the wisecracking to a minimum for a little while.
